programs.title: Civilisations: Rise and Fall
programs.desc: The creators of the documentary will present ancient Egypt, the powerful Roman Empire, the Aztecs and Japanese samurai.Each of these civilizations was powerful and seemed destined to last forever.

programs.title: Alexander Armstrong in Sri Lanka
programs.desc: After the economic crisis that occurred in 2022, Sri Lanka is opening up to tourists again.As a result of the pandemic and the suspension of tourist traffic, the country suffered economically.There were riots, including:storming the president's house by 700,000 citizens.Sri Lanka, which until 1972 was called Ceylon, is visited by actor and comedian Alexander Armstrong.He admires the charms of a diverse and multicultural country, which is no stranger to civil wars and natural disasters.He sees ritual exorcisms and is skilled in the ancient martial art of Angampora.He also takes an oil bath and tries to keep up with the Sri Lankan fishermen who fish on stilts.

programs.title: Solar System
programs.desc: The host of the program, Professor Brian Cox, presents selected information about the solar system.Viewers will learn about planets and moons covered with volcanoes that erupt with fire and ice.In the following parts, the scientist talks about the most interesting atmospheric conditions that were noticed on celestial bodies neighboring the Earth.He visits landscapes created by dust whirls, mountains covered with metallic frost and monsoon rains on one of the moons.Additionally, Professor Cox will introduce viewers to frozen regions of the solar system, including a dwarf planet with mountains of solid ice floating on it, as well as a black and white moon.

programs.title: Frozen Planet II: Making Of
programs.desc: Behind the scenes of a nature super-production devoted to the frosty regions of Earth.Viewers will see reports from the set, the most interesting parts of the picture and the challenges the filmmakers faced.
